title: Has anyone made comparison between Astra, Sol and older Claude/GPT models?
author: klas-klattermus
selftext:
I recently restarted a little hobby project from scratch because the code was a bit ugly, so I have an idea of what it involved last time I implemented the same feature.

This time I had a bunch of credits due tomorrow and decided to feed it into Astra and using a Godot MCP. It implemented the feature "one-shot" as a they say, and while it was faster than when I used GPT 5.4 it was also way more expensive.

For what I'm doing Astra isn't cost effective, and I'm not even sure how much of the work was thanks to it being better and how much was due to me already having implemented the feature before which led me to be able to cover some details I didn't specify right off the bat the first time around. But what's your guys experience with Astra so far when doing things you already know how to do with other models? 

Where does it really shine?
